name: Playwright
summary: Web testing and automation framework that drives Chromium, Firefox and WebKit through a single API.
description: Playwright Test is an end-to-end test runner with auto-waiting, web-first assertions, isolated browser contexts, parallelism and tracing. The same project provides a library for browser automation scripts (screenshots, PDFs, scraping), a CLI and an MCP server for coding and AI agents, and a VS Code extension with test generation, locator picking and a trace viewer; bindings exist for Python, .NET and Java.
contains: drives Chromium, Firefox and WebKit with a single API
test runner with auto-waiting, web-first assertions and test isolation
CLI and MCP server for coding and AI agents
library for screenshots, PDF generation and scraping
VS Code extension with codegen, locator picker and trace viewer
